text: {"lessons":["Selling Stock E, B, and D after gains may have cut off further upside; I should not use my average cost as a reason to sell or hold.","My account rose after I bought several stocks, but random price moves mean this run does not predict future returns; I should avoid chasing recent gains.","Before any trade, I should consider the portfolio as a whole, including available cash and position sizes, and make decisions based on my plan rather than reluctance to realize a loss."]}
